Hello camtrapR team and forum!
I just got to know about camtrapR and I would love to use it to produce spreadsheets for each species,location,etc. Unfortunately I am a novice in using R and I have not attended any course to learn camtrapR.
 I have already seen in the forum here that there are no educational videos or tutorials on camtrapR, so I was wondering if anyone could help me on how to upload my data into R/camtrapR to create spreadsheets for further analysis? I already renamed (using ReNamer) and sorted my CT data by location,species,# of species. I hope my question is not too dumb to be bothered with, any help is greatly appreciated!
Regards,
Marius Joscha Maiwald

Hi Marius, 
thank you for your interest in camtrapR. I am afraid you will need at least a basic understanding of R to use the package and benefit from it. You can easily find many R tutorials on the web. 

For camtrapR, the best starting point is the publication and the package vignettes. The package provides sample data and the vignettes walk you through the analyses. The sample data give you an idea how your spreadsheets should look like. Try this in R:
data(camtraps)
data(recordTableSample)

From what I understand, you already stored the images in the right directory structure. You may want to run the recordTable function to tabulate the camera trap photos next.

What analyses do you wish to do? 

Best regards,
Jürgen
